usageNotes: Permanently removes a firewall rule at the specified position from an SDN vnet's firewall rule set. Rules below the deleted position are renumbered downward, so rely on position only within a single atomic operation. Use the `digest` parameter to guard against concurrent edits — fetch the current digest from the GET endpoint before deleting.

examples.summary: Delete firewall rule at position 2 for vnet 'webapp01' with a digest guard

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the firewall rule at the specified position; the rule cannot be recovered and remaining rules are renumbered immediately.
tips: Omitting `pos` targets position 0 (the first rule) — always supply an explicit position to avoid accidental deletion of the wrong rule.
Rules are renumbered after deletion, so if deleting multiple rules in a loop, iterate from the highest position downward.
Requires SDN.Allocate on '/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>' — confirm the calling token or user has this privilege before running.
The operation returns null on success; any HTTP error (403, 500) indicates the rule was not deleted.
